description:
Replace serde_json::Value patch sites in jmap-calendars-server (event.rs, calendar.rs, participant_identity.rs) and jmap-calendars-client (HashMap<Id, serde_json::Value> update args) with jmap_types::PatchObject. Also: change SetObject::Patch impls in jmap-calendars-types from 'type Patch = serde_json::Value' to 'type Patch = PatchObject'. Wire format unchanged (serde transparent). Adoption-only bead — base type already lives in jmap-types per JMAP-o7cj.

Approval gate: jmap-calendars-types is not locked but is a public-API change to the SetObject::Patch associated type. Any caller pattern-matching on Patch will need to migrate. Coordinate with Mark before landing.
title: Adopt PatchObject in jmap-calendars-{server,client,types}
